name: valve-schedules
description: Per-valve schedule plan read and write on a fresh gateway: token gates, valve ownership checks, schedule validation, the weekly plan push through the fake gRPC and the compiled read-back (routes #14 and #15).

steps.why: Start with owned, foreign and unclaimed device records. Radio provisioning only creates or claims a device for the caller and cannot reproduce all these starting states.

steps.why: Represent ACK, loss and a legacy malformed schedule without changing the harness.
Move the persisted debounce clock past 30 seconds and mark the fixture valve clocks fresh, so the valve clock tick observes only the Gen2 plan delivery.
steps.sql: UPDATE valve_settings SET last_clock_sync_queued_at=strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now') WHERE device_eui IN ('A840410000000002','A840410000000006'); UPDATE app_settings SET value=json_set(value,'$.edited_at','2020-01-01T00:00:00.000Z') WHERE key='valve_snapshot_pending:A840410000000006'; UPDATE app_settings SET value=json_set(value,'$.edited_at',strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')) WHERE key='valve_snapshot_pending:A840410000000002';

steps.why: A persisted uncertain enqueue can outlive a restart. Seed its journal directly so the GET tests the confirmation write.
The observation worker settled this fixture earlier. Keep the expectation pending observation to test the queue flush fence.
A linked fixture supplies an outbox destination and sets the Gen2 clear-prefix operator flag. The oracle sync timers stay paused.
Remove the synthetic link before testing unrelated refusal paths.
Fault injection tests the route rollback and generic error body.
steps.sql: CREATE TRIGGER schedules_test_fail BEFORE INSERT ON valve_schedules BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'synthetic schedule failure'); END

steps.why: Supply a cloud-managed conditional schedule and a policy tombstone to reach both schedule mode guards.
steps.sql: INSERT INTO irrigation_policies(policy_uuid,zone_uuid,condition_json,timezone) SELECT 'synthetic-plan-policy',zone_uuid,'{}','UTC' FROM irrigation_zones WHERE id=1; INSERT INTO valve_schedules(schedule_uuid,device_eui,kind,weekdays_mask,start_time,duration_minutes,timezone,condition_policy_uuid) VALUES('synthetic-weekly','A840410000000004','WEEKLY',1,'11:00',20,'UTC','synthetic-plan-policy');
